patch_description: The current program runs a single symmetric ring initialization, which gets trapped in a poor local optimum (0.49 vs 0.70 for the earlier free-hill-climbing approach). Two improvements: (1) run the gradient ascent + pattern search pipeline from multiple diverse seeds (different ring radii and jitter levels) and keep the best, and (2) select/score candidates using the *true* objective min_area / hull_area, including a hull-expansion move (scaling all points outward) inside the pattern search, since pushing points toward the hexagon boundary increases min triangle area while hull area stays capped at the hexagon area.
